concept: EC2 purchasing: Compute Savings Plans — discount with family flexibility
tests: Choosing a purchase model for a steady 24/7 load over 3 years with the ability to change instance family.
expected: 3-year Compute Savings Plan: deep discount that applies to any family, size, Region, plus Fargate/Lambda. Triggers: "steady 24/7 baseline", "three years", "flexibility to change instance family".
why_not: On-Demand is the most expensive for a constant load; Spot is for interruptible jobs; a Standard RI is tied to an instance family.
